title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-11-19
headline: Pope Leo returns to a small town high in the Andes

questions.prompt: Who visited a small town in the Andes?
questions.hintKo: The leader of the Catholic Church made the visit.

hintI18n.zh-Hans: 天主教会领袖进行了这次访问。

He was bishop of the region before

questions.prompt: How many people came to see him, according to the Vatican?
questions.hintKo: The church says twenty thousand. The town has six thousand.

hintI18n.ja: 教会は2万人だと言っています。町の人口は6千人です。

hintI18n.de: Die Kirche sagt zwanzigtausend. Die Stadt hat sechstausend Einwohner.
